basic_details.job_title: IIT Guwahati Junior Research Fellow Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: IIT Guwahati Recruitment 2026 has one JRF(GATE) post in the research project "Futuristic risk assessment of temperature-humidity extremes due to climate change on human well-being and energy demand in the Indian sub-continent" at the School of Interdisciplinary Studies and Sustainability. The post is for 11 months. It pays Rs. 37000 plus Rs. 5920 HRA, a total of Rs. 42920. Applicants need a Graduate / Post Graduate Degree in a professional course and must have been selected through GATE, NET or a national-level examination. Applications are made online on the R&D Cell recruitment portal until

content_sections.heading: About IIT Guwahati JRF(GATE)
content_sections.text: The vacancy is advertised by the Research and Development Section of the Indian Institute of Technology Guwahati, Guwahati-781039, Assam. The post supports a research project at the School of Interdisciplinary Studies and Sustainability. The project studies the risk of temperature-humidity extremes caused by climate change and their effect on human well-being and energy demand in the Indian sub-continent. Sreeja Pekkat is the project's Principal Investigator.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The notice prints the qualification for the JRF(GATE) post as follows: Graduate / Post Graduate Degree in a professional course such as Water Resources Engg. / Energy /Electrical Engg., selected through a process described through any one of the following: 1. Scholars selected through GATE or National Eligibility Test CSIRUGC NET including lectureship (Assistant Professorship). 2. The selection process through National Level examinations conducted by Central Government Departments and their Agencies and institutions such as DST, DBT, DAE, DOs, DRDO, MHRD, ICAR, ICMR, IISc, IISER etc. Experience in Machine learning, Remote sensing and climate change will be preferred. content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IIT Guwahati JRF(GATE)
content_sections.text: Go to the Recruitment Portal of the Research & Development Cell, IIT Guwahati (iitg.ac.in/rndproj/recruitment/). Find the position by searching for the project title "Futuristic risk assessment of temperature-humidity extremes due to climate change on human well-being and energy demand in the Indian sub-continent". Follow the instructions and guidelines on the portal carefully and complete the online application. Submit the application by the last date, 2 November 2026 (Monday). For technical help with the online application, email [email protected] . For questions about the post, contact Sreeja Pekkat (Principal Investigator) by email at [email protected] or by phone at 9435707140.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Selection for the IIT Guwahati JRF(GATE) post is based only on the candidate's performance in the online interview. Interview date: 4 November 2026 (Wednesday) Time: 10.00 am Mode: Online. The interview link will be shared with eligible candidates one day before the interview date. No separate call letter will be sent to candidates.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in IIT Guwahati Recruitment 2026 for JRF(GATE)?
faq.answer: There is 01 JRF(GATE) vacancy in the climate change project at the School of Interdisciplinary Studies and Sustainability, IIT Guwahati.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the IIT Guwahati JRF(GATE) post?
faq.answer: The last date to apply is 2 November 2026 (Monday).

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is needed for the IIT Guwahati JRF(GATE) post?
faq.answer: Applicants need a Graduate / Post Graduate Degree in a professional course such as Water Resources Engg. / Energy /Electrical Engg. They must also have been selected through GATE, CSIRUGC NET including lectureship (Assistant Professorship), or a national-level examination conducted by Central Government Departments and their Agencies and institutions such as DST, DBT, DAE, DOs, DRDO, MHRD, ICAR, ICMR, IISc, IISER etc.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary of the IIT Guwahati JRF(GATE) post?
faq.answer: The pay is Rs. 37000 plus Rs. 5920 HRA, with Rs. 0 for medical, a total amount of Rs. 42920.

faq.question: Q5. How do I apply for the IIT Guwahati JRF(GATE) post?
faq.answer: Apply online on the Recruitment Portal of the Research & Development Cell, IIT Guwahati (iitg.ac.in/rndproj/recruitment/). Search the portal for the project title and follow the instructions there.

faq.question: Q6. How will candidates be selected for the IIT Guwahati JRF(GATE) post?
faq.answer: Selection is based on performance in the online interview, which will be held on 4 November 2026 (Wednesday) at 10.00 am.

faq.question: Q7. Will a call letter be sent for the online interview?
faq.answer: No. Candidates will not be sent a separate call letter. The interview link will be shared with eligible candidates one day before the interview date.

faq.answer: The appointment is for 11 months, in the project "Futuristic risk assessment of temperature-humidity extremes due to climate change on human well-being and energy demand in the Indian sub-continent".
